summary: Desktop and mobile portfolio flows passed, including hero, navigation, four projects/images, responsive menu, required contact fields, and successful POST /api/contact. Backend validation has one failure: empty strings are accepted by the contact API.

critical.issue: Payloads with empty name, email, project_type, and message return 200 and are persisted instead of being rejected.

action_items: Add non-empty/minimum-length validation to all ContactInquiry fields, including a real email constraint, then rerun the API regression test.
critical_code_review_comments: ContactInquiry uses unconstrained str fields, so browser required attributes are bypassable through the public API.
seed_data_creation: Created two TEST_ contact inquiries through the public contact endpoint during validation; no seeded records were modified.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Hero, section navigation, mobile menu, responsive overflow, four project images, Behance project links, form required behavior, and successful contact submission passed. Retest empty/whitespace contact payload validation after backend schema changes.
rca of the issue: The frontend only enforces required fields in the browser. Backend ContactInquiry declares plain str fields without min_length or email validation, so JSON empty strings satisfy Pydantic and create_contact_inquiry inserts them before returning 200.
